# THIRA

> THIRA is a women-centred technology and ideas conclave in Kochi, Kerala, India, brought to you by IEEE MEC Student Branch WIE.

## About

THIRA creates an inclusive space for people to listen, question, engage and discover new perspectives. Its themes include technology, careers, leadership, innovation, creativity and the journeys of women choosing their own paths.

## Programme

- Technical talks about emerging technology and evolving technical fields.
- Conversations about careers beyond familiar paths, including finance, filmmaking, theatre and management.
- Lightning talks featuring personal journeys and concise stories.
- Panel discussions that bring different experiences and viewpoints into one conversation.
- Keynote conversations about resilience, change, detours and growth.
- Plenary sessions exploring how different disciplines and perspectives fit together.
- Stalls and experiences for exploration, discovery and community.

## Location and Audience

THIRA is based in Kochi (also known as Cochin), Kerala, India, and welcomes attendees from Kochi, across Kerala and throughout South India. The event celebrates the voices and journeys of women while welcoming everyone who wants to listen, participate and learn.
